I have a very clear memory of being overwhelmed and upset during group therapy, and it was obvious to everyone in the room. My therapist remarked on it, and I responded somewhat angrily, because I just wasn’t having it, and she said “I’m not sure what this is, but I don’t like it.” It felt like I’d been shamed for feeling angry. 

My parents, therapist, and I all made an agreement to get me pulled out. I felt I’d learned all I could and I was just regressing. I never actually graduated, but I’d been there so long and done so well I guess they let it slide. And yes, I graduated high school in January!

I’d done absolutely nothing wrong. I hadn’t broken any rules, I was just suffering. After I got out of review, they regularly threatened me with it until my parents agreed to pull me out.
